page_title: FIO 1-0 LEC | Fiorentina v Lecce 28/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Marco Sala (Lecce) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' Here comes a substitution. Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Nicolo Zaniolo.
87' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Dodo is replaced by Matias Moreno (Fiorentina).
87' A brilliant individual effort! Danilo Veiga (Lecce) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the left post.
86' Livio Marinelli shows the yellow card to Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) for a heavy challenge.
86' Marco Giampaolo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Danilo Veiga (Lecce) replacing Frederic Guilbert.
81' The game has come to an end for Marin Pongracic. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina).
80' An attempted cross from Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) is cleared.
77' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle and it's Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
73' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) fails to score from the penalty as his shot only hits the right post.
73' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

72' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to Fiorentina!
72' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
72' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Fiorentina earn a corner.
71' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
69' The manager makes a subsitution with Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) coming on for Danilo Cataldi.
69' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
68' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) sends a cross into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone comes off his line to gather the ball.
67' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) comes onto the pitch for Jesper Karlsson.
64' Marco Giampaolo has decided to substitute Medon Berisha and he is replaced by Ante Rebic (Lecce).
64' Substitution. Marco Sala (Lecce) has come on for Antonino Gallo.
63' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fiorentina.
61' Today's referee Livio Marinelli rightly decides to book Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) for his harsh tackle.
59' Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
58' Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
57' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
55' Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
53' Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) was too forceful with his tackle and Livio Marinelli interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
52' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) heads on.
51' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Livio Marinelli didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
50' The foul by Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) was seen by Livio Marinelli who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
48' Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) takes the corner but it's cleared.

48' Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Lecce win a corner kick.
47' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
46' Dodo (Fiorentina) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Livio Marinelli shows a yellow card to Medon Berisha (Lecce), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' None of the Lecce players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

45' David de Gea makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Jesper Karlsson (Lecce) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom right corner. It will be a corner kick for Lecce.
42' Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
41' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) commits a foul and Livio Marinelli immediately signals a free kick.
39' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
37' Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
36' The ball is cleared after Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
34' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) takes it short.
34' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fiorentina comes to nothing.
32' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina), but the defence gets it clear.
31' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Tete Morente (Lecce) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
28' Wladimiro Falcone displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
28' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for an infringement.
27' Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
25' Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
21' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

18' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) produced a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but David de Gea thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
17' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Livio Marinelli ignores the protests.
16' Flag goes up against Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
14' Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
11' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Fiorentina.
9' 1 - 0 Goal! Dodo is the provider and Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is the executioner, dispatching the cross into the right of the goal from close in with his head. 1:0.
9' The cross into the penalty area from Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
6' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
5' Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
4' Medon Berisha (Lecce) jumps into a tackle and Livio Marinelli signals a foul.
3' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
1' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Fiorentina will take the kick-off.
Livio Marinelli is the one to supervise the game today.
